data.title: Meduza: ‘I trusted Argentina, but it deceived me’: Tougher immigration rules and soaring costs are making Russian émigrés rethink their new lives in South America
data.summary: Argentina has become a distant but fairly popular destination for Russian emigration. The South American country has been especially attractive to couples having children, since citizenship there is granted by birthright.
